topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture by connecting to prior practical sessions and outlining the main learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral Origins and Assays of Transforming Genes
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the historical study of tumor-causing viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the functional definitions, regulatory pathways, and genetic mechanisms that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Tumor Progression of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how cellular defects in DNA repair, replication, and chromosome segregation generate genetic instability to accelerate tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition Syndromes
topics.groupedBecause: They discuss how inherited germline mutations predispose individuals to cancer and shape tumor progression and therapeutic response.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with recommended reading and framing for the upcoming session.
